tasks.label: flash-openocd
args: $target = if ('${input:board}' -eq 'h723_mc02') { 'stm32h7x' } else { 'stm32f4x' }; $elf = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build/${input:board}/embedded_framework.elf'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $elf)) { Write-Error "Firmware not found: $elf. Build the selected board first."; exit 1 }; & openocd -f '${input:probe}' -f "target/$target.cfg" -c "program {$elf} verify reset exit"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
